review_evidence: README identifies the project as a practical Lean 4 implementation of Ray Tracing in One Weekend rather than a verification development.

Direct inspection found theorem/proof content in old/NatExtra.lean and old/vec.lean, including natural-number division lemmas and finite-vector/indexing results, so the source cannot be retired wholesale.

Main.lean and Render/Vec3.lean implement the renderer/vector runtime with structures and executable definitions but no proposition-level specifications or proofs; lakefile.lean is package configuration.

rules.content_invariant: The selected files contain runtime raytracing/vector code and package configuration, with no theorem, lemma, axiom, proof, or verified mathematical specification; theorem-bearing utility files remain primary-searchable.
evidence: Complete declaration scan of the selected files found executable definitions/structures only; proposition declarations occur in the retained old/NatExtra.lean and old/vec.lean modules.
rules.rationale: Exclude the exact executable raytracer/vector implementation files and Lake build configuration while preserving the theorem-bearing old utility modules.

summary: Retain the old theorem-bearing utility modules from the Lean raytracer, while excluding the executable raytracer/configuration files.
